name: TweetClaw
description: Post tweets, reply, like, retweet, follow, DM, search, and monitor X/Twitter through structured Xquik endpoints.

apiKey.description: Xquik API key (get one at dashboard.xquik.com). Required for account-backed X automation.

tempoSigningKey.description: MPP signing key for pay-per-use mode. No account needed. 32 read-only X-API endpoints.

apiKey.label: Xquik API Key
apiKey.help: Account-backed X automation. Generate at dashboard.xquik.com.

tempoSigningKey.label: MPP Signing Key
tempoSigningKey.help: Pay-per-use mode via Machine Payments Protocol. No account needed. 32 read-only X-API endpoints only.

baseUrl.label: API Base URL
baseUrl.help: Only change if using a self-hosted Xquik instance.

pollingInterval.label: Event Poll Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.help: How often to check for new monitor events. Default: 60 seconds.

pollingEnabled.label: Enable Event Notifications
pollingEnabled.help: Deliver monitor alerts and extraction completions to your chat.
